thread:
jessica: FYI customer hit a pretty bad alignment issue on the batch-rerank endpoint. They sent multiple queries in one request and some candidate lists appear to be shifted.

jessica: Customer report snippet: 'We got results where candidates mapped to the wrong query, sometimes duplicated or dropped. Scores don't line up with candidate arrays.'

jessica: Repro payload (redacted ids):
```json
{
  \"queries\": [\"find stores near me\", \"return policy refund\"],
  \"candidates\": [
    {\"id\": \"c1\", \"text\": \"store A\"},
    {\"id\": \"c2\", \"text\": \"store B\"},
    {\"id\": \"c3\", \"text\": \"policy page\"}
  ],
  \"per_query_candidate_counts\": [2, 1],
  \"expect_per_query\": [ [\"c1\",\"c2\"], [\"c3\"] ]
}
```

jessica: Response they got (truncated):
```json
{
  \"scores\": [0.76, 0.42, 0.88],
  \"assigned_candidates\": [\"c1\", \"c3\", \"c2\"]  // appears shuffled
}
```

ryan: can you paste the exact request headers + SDK version? need to rule out client-side flattening.

jessica: curl sample they used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank/batch -H 'Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data @payload.json` they used python-sdk 0.9.4. No retries configured.

meera: two quick hypotheses: 1) server-side "flatten then chunk" optimization might be losing per-query boundaries for small miscounts; 2) per_query_candidate_counts field ignored when candidates are provided as objects instead of nested arrays.

meera: do we have any recent changes in the batching path that touch per-query offsets? I recall a PR that switched to a shared-buffer layout for candidates (PR #2548).

ryan: digging logs now. jessica can you include the request id? customer gave x-request-id: req_0b3f2a9e in their support ticket.

jessica: added request id to thread and uploaded the raw request/response.

sre-lina: infra note: around the request time we had elevated tail latency on rerank host pool (3x p50/p95). There were also 2 automatic retries from the SDK within their client logs — that may have caused duplicate processing in batch path leading to offsets being applied incorrectly. cc @ryan

ryan: found a stacktrace in host logs referencing candidate_indexing.go: line 182. Looks like an off-by-one when calculating start offsets when a previous chunk is empty. Reproducing locally with their exact payload + simulated retry gives the shifted mapping.

ryan: minimal repro: send two queries where the first has 0 candidates and the second has N candidates, then enable the server-side "compact" path. I can push a small test to a feature branch.

meera: thanks — if it's the compact path, fallback should be to the safe per-query flattening algorithm. We should also add validation to reject requests where per_query_candidate_counts sum != candidates.length. That would have caught this.

oliver: flagged for account team. Customer is sensitive — they saw apparent mismatched results in production and asked about billing for affected calls. Can support offer a credit if we confirm a server bug?

jessica: customer asked for repro steps and ETA. I'll propose: 1) confirm bug (ryan), 2) mitigations (rollback/flag fallback), 3) patch + release, 4) credit review with finance.

deploy-bot: Deployed unit-test fix to ci/rerank-compact-path branch (build 3421). Integration tests queued. :rocket:

ryan: I have a local branch that reproduces the shift + unit tests. Next step: add guard in server to verify per_query_candidate_counts and reject mismatches with 400 and error code `batch_format_mismatch`. That will make failures explicit instead of silently shifting.

sre-lina: also proposing a short-term mitigation: disable the compact path behind a config flag on prod pool for 1 hour -> monitor error/success mapping and latency.

meera: add a regression test for SDK retry behavior + server de-dup path — ensure repeated transmissions do not change offsets.

jessica: action items:
- ryan: push PR with guard + tests, and a small rollback plan (ETA 3h)
- sre-lina: toggle compact-path flag if we see >1% misaligned responses in the next 30m
- meera: add regression to rerank CI for multi-query/padded candidates
- oliver: draft support reply & propose provisional credit policy

jessica: assigning owner = ryan. I'll update the customer once ryan confirms repro. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ryan: starting the PR now. will update thread with link.

jessica: customer-facing note draft: "We identified an internal batching optimization that in rare cases can misinterpret per-query candidate boundaries when combined with client retries. We're working on a patch and will follow up with remediation and credits if needed."

oliver: looks good, add timeline "we expect an initial mitigation within 3 hours and a full patch within 48 hours"

jessica: added timeline. saving thread for audit.
